LanguageData.LP_TenderLovin.label: tender lovin'
LanguageData.LP_TenderLovin.description:
Walk to the target and spend some tender time together. Afterwards both get the same mood as vanilla lovin' ("got some lovin'"), and it also counts as lovin': the next lovin' cooldown is recalculated as in vanilla, and a highmate's lovin' dependency is satisfied; with Biotech, opposite-sex couples have the same pregnancy chance as vanilla (depending on both parties' family planning, sterilization, etc.).

Unlike "promiscuous lovin'", this doesn't count as cheating: both parties' existing lover, partner, fiancé and spouse relationships stay unchanged.

The target must be an adult humanlike, conscious and not hostile, in the same faction or a prisoner / slave of this colony; can't be asexual or a blood relative, and their opinion of the caster must be at least 0 (no limit between lovers).
